abilities.name: Fate — Aspects
abilities.entry:
High Concept: The Scarred Brute of Nine Spoons
Trouble: A Murderer’s Reputation Never Dies

  • I Follow Mr. Byl. Don’t Ask Why.
  • Anything Within Reach Is a Weapon
  • One Look Is Usually Enough.

abilities.name: Fate — Skills
abilities.entry:
• Superb (+5): Physique
  • Great (+4): Fight
  • Good (+3): Notice, Will
  • Fair (+2): Athletics, Provoke, Stealth
  • Average (+1): Burglary, Contacts, Crafts, Shoot

abilities.name: Fate — Stunts
abilities.entry:
Improvised Butchery: +2 to Fight when attacking with something never intended to be a weapon, provided it breaks, becomes unusable, or is discarded after the exchange.

Behind Me: Once per scene, when someone in Lott’s zone is attacked, he may place himself between them and the attacker. Lott becomes the target and makes the defense roll.

One Look: Lott may use Notice instead of Empathy to determine whether someone intends immediate violence, is concealing a weapon, or is preparing an ambush.

abilities.name: Fate — Stress & Refresh
abilities.entry:
Refresh: 3
Physical Stress: 4 boxes
Mental Stress: 3 boxes

Consequences: Mild (2), Moderate (4), Severe (6), plus one additional Mild Physical Consequence from exceptional Physique.

abilities.name: Fate — Kils
abilities.entry: Lott’s enormous antique sailor’s cutlass. When weapon ratings are being used, Kils is Weapon:2. It is conspicuous, difficult to conceal, and recognizable to people familiar with Nine Spoons.
